title: Chromosome-scale genome assembly of kiwifruit Actinidia eriantha
author: Wei Tang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vgse3we

steps.title: Pre-process Sequencing Reads
steps.instruction: Clean and trim the raw sequencing reads using a series of deduplication and trimming tools.

substeps.instruction: Perform optional deduplication using super_deduper with parameters: -s 5 -l 40 -p prefix -1 read1.fq -2 read2.fq
Trim adaptors using Trimmomatic (v0.35) with parameters: PE -phred33 ILLUMINACLIP:TruSeq3-PE.fa:2:30:10 LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 MINLEN:25
Clean mate-pair reads using nextclip with parameters: --remove_duplicates --min_length 20 --number_of_reads 60 --log log.txt --number_of_reads 10000000 -i read1.fq -j read2.fq -o out

steps.title: Perform De Novo Assembly
steps.instruction: Generate initial genome assemblies using Canu and wtdbg.

substeps.instruction: Run Canu with parameters: -p prefix corOutCoverage=50 -d pacbio_all genomeSize=705m -pacbio-raw Pacbio.fastq.gz

Align subreads using pbalign with parameters: --tmpDir tmp --nproc 6 --concordant --hitPolicy randombest --minAccuracy 70 --minLength 50 --algorithmOptions "--minMatch 12 --bestn 10 --minPctIdentity 70.0"
Call variants using variantCaller with parameters: -j 64 --algorithm arrow -r contigs.fasta --coverage 150 --diploid --minConfidence 40 --minCoverage 5
Run wtdbg (v1.1.006) with parameters: -t 96 -i pb-reads.fa -o dbg -H -k 21 -S 1.02 -e 3
Run wtdbg-cns with parameters: -t 96 -i dbg.ctg.lay -o dbg.ctg.lay.fa -k 15

steps.title: Merge and Polish Assemblies
steps.instruction: Combine assemblies and refine the sequence using Pilon.

substeps.instruction: Merge assemblies using Quickmerge via merge_wrapper.py assembly1.fasta assembly2.fasta
Align reads using bowtie2 with parameters: --rf --no-unal -I min -X max -x index -1 read1.fq -2 read2.fq -S align.sam

Polish the genome using pilon (v1.22) with parameters: -Xmx300G --genome contig.fa --frags PE.bam --jumps MP.bam --output out --outdir outdir --changes --vcf --tracks --diploid --fix snps,indels --threads 60 --flank 0

steps.title: Anchor Genome Scaffolds
steps.instruction: Anchor the assembly using LACHESIS with the following parameters: CLUSTER_MIN_RE_SITES=48, CLUSTER_MAX_LINK_DENSITY=2, CLUSTER_NONINFORMATIVE_RATIO=2, ORDER_MIN_N_RES_IN_TRUN=14, ORDER_MIN_N_RES_IN_SHREDS=15

steps.title: Identify and Mask Repeats
steps.instruction: Identify MITEs and LTRs to mask the genome and find novel repeats.

substeps.instruction: Identify MITEs using MITE_Hunter_manager.pl with parameters: -i assembly.fasta -n 64 -c 64 -S 12345678
Create MITE library by concatenating genome_Step8_*.fa and genome_Step8_singlet.fa into MITE.lib
Identify LTRs following the MAKER-P protocol (Campbell et al. 2014)
Mask the genome using RepeatMasker with parameters: -pa 64 -lib MITE_LTR.lib -dir . assembly.fasta

Identify novel repeats using RepeatModeler: first run rmaskedpart.pl assembly.fasta.masked 50, then BuildDatabase (-name umseqfiledb -engine ncbi umseqfile), then RepeatModeler (-pa 64 -database umseqfiledb)

steps.title: Prepare Transcriptome Evidence
steps.instruction: Generate transcriptome evidence through de novo, genome-guided, and StringTie assemblies.

substeps.instruction: Perform de novo assembly with Trinity: --seqType fq --max_memory 200G --CPU 50 --normalize_reads --left r1.fq --right r2.fq --output trinity_denovo

Perform genome-guided assembly with STAR: --genomeDir gd --alignIntronMax 80000 --twopassMode Basic --runThreadN 50 --readFilesCommand zcat --readFilesIn r1.fq r2.fq --outFileNamePrefix mapped_starTrinity --genome_guided_bam mapped_starAligned.out.s.bam --max_memory 200G --genome_guided_max_intron 80000 --CPU 50 --output trinity_GG
Combine Trinity outputs: cat Trinity-DN.fasta Trinity-GG.fasta > transcripts.fasta
Perform StringTie assembly: run hisat2 --dta -p 64 -x assembly.fasta -1 r1.fq -2 r2.fq -S hisat2.map.sam, then run stringtie hisat2.map.sort.bam -o stringtie.gtf -p 60

Run PASA pipeline using accession_extractor.pl and Launch_PASA_pipeline.pl with parameters: --MAX_INTRON_LENGTH 60000 --cufflinks_gtf stringtie.gtf -C -R --CPU 64 -g aseembly.fa -t transcripts.fasta --TDN tdn.accs --ALIGNERS blat,gmap

steps.title: Predict Genes and Annotate
steps.instruction: Train models and predict genes using Braker and MAKER-P.

substeps.instruction: Train models with braker.pl using parameters: --cores=64 --BAMTOOLS_PATH=bamtools-2.4.1-0/bin --AUGUSTUS_BIN_PATH=/bin --AUGUSTUS_CONFIG_PATH=config --AUGUSTUS_SCRIPTS_PATH=/bin --genome=assembly.fa --species=species --softmasking=1 --prot_seq=homologous_protein.fa --prg=spaln --ALIGNMENT_TOOL_PATH=spaln/bin --bam=rnaseq.sort.bam
Perform gene prediction and integration following the MAKER-P protocol (Campbell et al. 2014)

steps.title: Assess Assembly Quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate the assembly and protein set using BUSCO.

substeps.instruction: Run BUSCO on proteins: python run_BUSCO.py -i protein.fa -o pep_busco -l embryophyta_odb9/ -m proteins -c 60
Run BUSCO on genome: python run_BUSCO.py -i Actinidia_eriantha.chr.fa -o genome_busco -l embryophyta_odb9/ -m genome -c 60 -sp tomato
Count k-mers: jellyfish count -C -m 17 -s 10000000000 -t 40 -o db.jf *.fq
Generate histogram: jellyfish histo -t 40 db.jf > db.histo

steps.title: Construct Orthogroups and Phylogeny
steps.instruction: Identify orthogroups and build a maximum likelihood phylogeny.

substeps.instruction: Construct orthogroups using orthofinder: -t 64 -M msa -A mafft -I 1.5 -f dir

For each single-copy orthogroup: align with mafft (--maxiterate 1000 --localpair --thread 60), trim with trimal (-automated1), construct ML tree with iqtree (-s ${i}.mafft.trimal -nt AUTO), and root the tree using rice as outgroup with ete3 mod
Concatenate alignments of consistent gene trees and run final ML phylogeny: iqtree -s alignment.phy -nt AUTO

steps.title: Perform Molecular Dating and Evolution Analysis
steps.instruction: Estimate divergence times and gene family evolution.

substeps.instruction: Run MCMCTree using 'Relaxed rate' with constraints: 5-10 mya for tomato/potato, < 5 mya for two kiwifruits, and root limit 150 mya

Analyze gene family evolution with CAFE: filter large families using python CAFE/python_scripts/cafetutorial_clade_and_size_filter.py -i Orthogroups.GeneCount.reformat -o largeFam -scafe tree tree_estimated_from_MCMCTree, then run load -i filtered_cafe_input.txt -filter -l filtered_cafe_input.logfile -p 0.05 lambda -sreport filtered_cafe_input.cafe
